basic_info.description: Experience the charm and character of San Francisco in this beautiful top-floor 2-bedroom, 1-bath Victorian condo, ideally located in the heart of the city. This beautifully maintained home offers the perfect blend of historic elegance and contemporary updates, creating a warm and inviting space filled with an abundance of natural light.    Step inside to discover high ceilings, original hardwood floors, and exquisite Victorian details throughout, adding timeless character to every corner. The updated eat-in kitchen is both spacious and functional, featuring tasteful upgrades while preserving its classic charm. A dedicated dining area provides an ideal setting for hosting guests or enjoying your everyday meals. There also a shared and tranquil outdoor yard and plenty of space for your home office.    Both bedrooms offer a peaceful space, creating comfortable retreats from the lively energy of the city. The bathroom maintains its vintage appeal with tasteful updates for modern convenience.    Situated just moments from vibrant restaurants, trendy bars, shopping, and exciting nightlife, this home also offers easy access to public transportation, making commuting a breeze.    A rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's history in an unbeatable location. This is a must-see!
